selection_criterion: Highest Validation Set Spam-Class F1-Score (with Threshold Tuning)

decision_tree.name: Decision Tree (Entropy)
decision_tree.description: Single Decision Tree using Entropy / Information Gain splits on hybrid word + char TF-IDF features.

logistic_regression.name: Logistic Regression
logistic_regression.description: L2-regularized Logistic Regression with balanced class weights; fast and highly effective on sparse TF-IDF text.

svm.name: Support Vector Machine (SVM)
svm.description: Linear Support Vector Machine (maximum-margin hyperplane) wrapped in probability calibration for smooth spam scores.

random_forest.name: Random Forest
random_forest.description: Bootstrap aggregation of 200 decorrelated trees with feature randomness to reduce variance.

adaboost.name: AdaBoost
adaboost.description: Sequential shallow trees that increase weights on previously misclassified messages.

gradient_boosting.name: Gradient Boosting (GBM)
gradient_boosting.description: Sequential additive model fitting each new weak tree to the negative gradient of log-loss.

xgboost.name: XGBoost
xgboost.description: Optimized second-order gradient boosting with L1/L2 regularization and column subsampling.

soft_voting.name: Soft-Voting Meta-Ensemble
soft_voting.description: Combines Linear SVM (35%), Logistic Regression (25%), Random Forest (20%), and XGBoost (20%) with validation-tuned threshold.

cce4_baseline.label: v1.0 Baseline (Word TF-IDF + 0.50 Cutoff, Random Forest)

cce5_enhanced.label: v2.0 Enhanced (Soft-Voting Meta-Ensemble + Hybrid TF-IDF + Tuned Cutoff)
